canonical_title: Team Building: Working Collaboratively with Colleagues
aliases: Maintain relationship with supervisor and colleagues

one_line_answer.text: Teams work well when all the team members work together.

cites.quote: Teams work well when all the team members work together.

bangla_explanation: Training প্রতিষ্ঠানে একা কাজ হয় না; colleagues-এর সাথে collaboratively কাজ করতে হয়।
দুইভাবে: information and ideas শেয়ার করা, আর একসাথে work outcomes অর্জন করা।
Team ভালো চলে পাঁচটা জিনিসে: commitment, cooperating, communicating, trust and support, flexible থাকা।
কেউ team goals না মানলে পুরো team-এর effectiveness আর learners-এর outcomes ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত হতে পারে।

example.en: Three electrical trainers at a TTC share one workshop. They agree the goals, share ideas and cover for each other.
example.bn: একই workshop-এর তিন trainer লক্ষ্য ঠিক করেন, ideas শেয়ার করেন, দরকারে একে অপরকে সাহায্য করেন।

mnemonic.text: C-C-C-T-F: Commitment, Cooperating, Communicating, Trust, Flexible
mnemonic.explain_bn: তিনটা C, তারপর T আর F — ভালো team-এর পাঁচ গুণ।

list_answer.title: What makes a team work well (team building)

items.text: Commitment: agreeing with the team goals, its outcomes and timeframes.
Cooperating: members have different skills and knowledge; they share ideas and learn from each other.

cites.quote: share ideas and learn from each other

items.text: Communicating: a problem may be solved before it becomes too difficult.

cites.quote: solved before it becomes too difficult

items.text: Trust and support: those you work with respect your work, encourage you and provide feedback.

cites.quote: those you work with respect your work

items.text: Being flexible: something may come up that was not planned.

cites.quote: something may come up that was not planned

items_bn: Commitment — team goals, outcomes আর timeframes-এর সাথে একমত হওয়া।
Cooperating — সবার skills and knowledge আলাদা; তাই ideas শেয়ার করে একে অপরের থেকে শেখা যায়।
Communicating — নিয়মিত কথা বললে problem বড় হওয়ার আগেই সমাধান হয়, tasks and goals পরিষ্কার থাকে।
Trust and support — colleagues আপনার কাজকে সম্মান করেন, উৎসাহ দেন, feedback দেন।
Flexible থাকা — অপরিকল্পিত কিছু ঘটলে, যেমন কেউ মত বদলালে, মানিয়ে নেওয়া।

short.prompt: How can a TVET teacher work collaboratively with colleagues? What makes a team work well?
short.modelAnswer:
A teacher works collaboratively with colleagues by:
1. sharing information and ideas; and
2. working together to achieve work outcomes.
Teams work well when all the team members work together. This involves:
1. being committed to the team goals
2. cooperating
3. communicating with each other
4. trusting and supporting each other
5. being flexible
